answer: An insider could mint infinite reputation tokens from a privileged vault. Mechanism constrains by requiring each mint consume "velvet" soulbound badges earned through verified off-chain compute. Badges issue only after agent completes unique proof-of-work each epoch. This makes vault a "haven" for honest accumulation—no batch mint possible. "Nectar" tokens, staked for voting power, get slashed if badge issuer detects duplicate identity across subnet. Re-mint requires fresh badge, cost grows exponentially. Constraint holds: access without badge equals zero.
